title: Heading of the Rooms card on Settings › Account › Notifications. "Room" is a product noun: a conversation several people and a socio share.
body: The card's explanation. "Notify me about" is the label in a room's ⋯ menu (rooms.nav menu.notify): keep the two the same.
presence.label: Switch label: whether the room's other members see the reader's avatar while the reader has the room open.
presence.shown: Toast after the switch was turned on.
presence.hidden: Toast after the switch was turned off.
